newsitem.title: USA: Wynn's to buy back 1.1 mln shares at $24.25.
newsitem.headline: Wynn's to buy back 1.1 mln shares at $24.25.

text.p: Wynn's International Inc said Tuesday it will buy back 1.1 million of its shares at $24.25 each in accordance with terms of a tender offer that expired at midnight April 22.

The company had offered to purchase cash up to 1.1 million shares, or about eight percent of its issued and outstanding stock, at a purchase price, net to the seller in cash, not greater than $25 nor less than $22 per share.

Because 1,597,354 shares were properly tendered at or below the price of $24.25, the number of shares purchased from each tendering stockholder (other than holders of fewer than 100 shares) was prorated. The final proration factor was 68.83 percent, Wynn's said.
